structure.title: Business Structure
structure.select_prompt: Select the legal form that best fits your business — Proclamation No. 1243/2021
structure.intro_desc: Company registration in Ethiopia is a legal process that establishes the foundation of a business relationship between founders, investors, government authorities, and third parties. The 2021 Commercial Code introduced the One-Person Company and Limited Liability Partnership — new structures that expand options for entrepreneurs. Careful planning, proper documentation, and compliance with registration and licensing requirements remain essential for successful operation.
structure.legal_essentials_body: Understanding requirements at the formation stage helps companies avoid future disputes, regulatory problems, and unnecessary costs. All structures require a Trade License, TIN registration, and commercial registration at the Ministry of Trade & Regional Integration. VAT registration is mandatory for annual turnover ≥ ETB 2,000,000 (Proc. 1341/2024).

step_descriptions.nid: Register with the National ID Program (NIDP) to get your 12-digit Fayda Identification Number — the root identity for all government systems.
step_descriptions.tin: Register at the Ministry of Revenues or your local Sub-City branch to receive your 10-digit TIN — the primary tax identifier required for all eTax portal access.
step_descriptions.license: Apply for and renew your commercial registration through the Ministry of Trade & Regional Integration. Your license must tie explicitly to your TIN and business address.
step_descriptions.vat: Businesses with annual gross income above ETB 2M must register for VAT at the Ministry of Revenues. You must present your TIN and Business License.
step_descriptions.crossref: Verify all identifiers are aligned on the e-Trade Platform and visit the Revenue Office to activate indirect taxes (VAT/TOT) in their administrative system.

success.title: Registration Harmonized
success.description: Your NID, TIN, Business License, and VAT identifiers have been linked. Your business is now registered across Ethiopian federal portals.

harmonization.nid_tin_linked: NID ↔ TIN linked on e-Trade Platform
harmonization.nid_tin_desc: Your Fayda NID and TIN are cross-referenced and your trade name matches legally.
harmonization.tin_license_desc: Your TIN is explicitly tied to your business license number in MoR records.
harmonization.license_vat_desc: Your VAT certificate references your current business license number.
harmonization.mor_desc: Visit the Revenue Office with original documents to activate indirect taxes (VAT/TOT).
harmonization.conflict_notes_hint: Optional — any discrepancies found during cross-referencing

nid_step.info_body: The Fayda Identification Number (FIN) is a biometric 12-digit number issued by the National ID Program. It serves as the root identity for all commercial, banking, and government systems in Ethiopia. Register at your nearest NIDP enrollment center.
nid_step.full_name_label: Full Legal Name (as registered with NIDP)

tin_step.info_body: Register at the Ministry of Revenues (for companies) or your local Sub-City branch. You will need your NID, Commercial Registration, and a verified Memorandum of Association (if applicable) to complete biometric registration.
tin_step.biometric_checkbox: Biometric registration at the Ministry of Revenues is complete

license_step.info_body: Apply for and renew your commercial registration via the Ministry of Trade & Regional Integration. Your license must explicitly tie to your TIN and the physical address of your premises.
license_step.vat_warning: Annual turnover ≥ ETB 2,000,000 — VAT registration is mandatory per Regulation No. 570/2025. Proceed to Step 4 to register.

vat_step.info_body: Businesses with annual gross income in Category A (≥ ETB 2,000,000) must register for VAT. Present your TIN and Business License at the MoR office. Once registered, you must purchase an ERCA-approved Electronic Cash Register (ECR/POS).
vat_step.penalty_warning: VAT returns are due on the 30th of the following month. Late filing incurs a penalty of ETB 500/day per Proclamation No. 1341/2024.

crossref_step.info_body: The final step verifies that all identifiers are aligned. Link your registered documents on the e-Trade Platform and visit the Revenue Office with originals to harmonize tax accounts and activate VAT/TOT in the administrative system.
crossref_step.conflict_notes_placeholder: e.g. Trade name mismatch between TIN and e-Trade records...

plc.label: Private Limited Company (PLC)
highlights: Most common structure for SMEs
Memorandum of Association required
Transfer of shares requires member consent
Cannot issue shares to the public

share_company.label: Share Company (SC)
highlights: Can raise capital from the public
Requires Articles of Incorporation
Board of Directors mandatory
Subject to ECMA regulation for public companies

one_person.label: One-Person Company (OPC)
highlights: New under 2021 Commercial Code reforms
Single founder with full liability protection
Ideal for solo entrepreneurs scaling up
Memorandum of Association by sole founder

llp.label: Limited Liability Partnership (LLP)
llp.taxRegime: Partnership income taxed at partner level
highlights: New under 2021 Commercial Code reforms
All partners have limited liability
Flexible internal governance
Suitable for professional service firms

general_partnership.label: General Partnership
general_partnership.taxRegime: Partnership income taxed at partner level
highlights: Simple formation — partnership deed required
All partners manage and are liable
No separate legal personality in some cases
Common for family businesses and trades

limited_partnership.label: Limited Partnership (Kommandit)
limited_partnership.taxRegime: Partnership income taxed at partner level
highlights: General partner manages and bears full liability
Limited partners are passive investors
Used for investment vehicles and joint ventures
Partnership deed must specify capital contributions

sole_proprietor.label: Sole Proprietorship
highlights: Simplest form — trade license only
No separate legal entity from the owner
Registered at Sub-City/Woreda trade bureau
Subject to TOT if turnover below ETB 2M

validation.fayda_invalid: Must be a 12-digit Fayda Identification Number
validation.vat_number_required: VAT number is required when registered
